data.name: 致命来访
data.detailed_description:
Deadly Visit is an immersive, suspenseful visual novel in a realistic style, where every small choice you make will have a butterfly effect, profoundly influencing the final outcome of the story.

◆ A Captivating Narrative Experience

• An Enigmatic Manor Mystery: Play as Diana, an investigator invited to a secret-filled ancient manor. The lord of the manor appears kind but is clearly preoccupied, and the mysterious maid behaves suspiciously. As the investigation deepens, a buried past gradually comes to light.

• Cinematic Story Presentation: Enjoy an immersive storytelling experience through exquisite character art, dynamic scenes, and carefully designed cinematography.

◆ Fate-Determining Key Choices

• Multi-dimensional Dialogue System: Interact with characters of diverse personalities. Your dialogue choices not only affect their favor but will also directly alter the story's branching paths.

• Tests of Morality and Reason: Face difficult choices involving trust, lies, and truth. There are no absolute right or wrong answers; every decision leads to an unknown ending.

◆ Moderate Exploration & Puzzle Gameplay

• Detailed Environmental Investigation: Search every corner of the manor for key items and hidden clues. Combine and analyze them to gradually uncover the truth.

• Lightweight Logic Puzzles: The game incorporates light puzzle-solving elements closely tied to the plot, focusing on the joy of thinking and discovery rather than complex operations.

◆ High Replay Value

• Intricate Multi-Ending System: The story features multiple drastically different endings (e.g., Truth Revealed, Accomplice, Eternal Silence, etc.). Your choices will lead to one unique finale.

• Hidden Plotlines & Collectibles: Multiple playthroughs are encouraged to unlock all storylines, character background files, and special collectibles.

Ready to step into the manor and write your own exclusive story?
